name: Atlassian Forge Monthly Free Allowance
free_limit: Per Forge app per month: 200,000 GB-seconds of Functions duration, 0.1 GB Key-Value reads and 0.1 GB writes, 1 GB log writes, 100,000 SQL compute requests and 730 GB-hours SQL data storage.
watch_out: Consumption above free allowances is billed monthly; LLM and container compute have zero free allowance. Atlassian's pricing FAQ asks for billing details, while Developer Space billing docs allow continued within-free usage without a payment method; confirm account requirements. Applies to Forge apps, not standalone serverless hosting.
